items.title: CEAT to Invest ₹1,205 Crore to Expand Two-Wheeler Tyre Capacity by 66%
items.summary: CEAT plans to invest around ₹1,205 crore to expand its two-wheeler tyre manufacturing capacity by about 66% as the existing capacity at its Nagpur plant nears full utilisation. The tyre maker will add around 53,000 tyres a day in phases by the end of FY31.

items.title: Gabriel India to Invest ₹180 Crore in New Capacity, Automation in FY27
items.summary: Gabriel India plans to invest around ₹180 crore in its standalone business in FY27, with the proposed spending covering a new plant at Hosur and capacity expansion across some of its existing facilities. The company expects a large part of its two-wheeler growth to come from the new Hosur facility, Atul Jaggi, Group President, ANAND Group, and Managing Director of Gabriel India, told Autocar Professional.

items.title: Sona Comstar and DENSO Form Joint Ventures for Electric Powertrains

items.title: Hungary investigates deal with China's BYD carmaker after ex-foreign minister takes job there

items.title: Shakti Pumps Invests ₹5 Crore in EV Mobility Subsidiary
items.summary: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has invested ₹5 crore in its wholly owned subsidiary, Shakti EV Mobility Private Limited, according to a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges. The capital infusion was executed through the cash subscription of 50 lakh equity shares possessing a face value of ₹10 each.

items.title: No eviction, only show-cause notice to Rajesh Exports in PLI battery scheme
items.summary: The MoHI is preparing to issue a show-cause notice to ACC Energy Storage in the next few days. The decision against evicting ACC Energy Storage came after the ministry sought legal opinion on the feasibility of evicting a beneficiary which has bagged its place after a global bidding process.
